status: DESIGN PRE-COMMITMENT (rules only; no data-derived constants yet)
written_before: any #1754 number-ranking, Top-N coverage, Super Ball or candidate-pool scoring analysis
any look at Super Lotto V1 walk-forward model-performance values (only the recorded fact 'no qualifying model' is known)
designer_disclosure: The designer knows the #1753 and #1754 results because the user stated them. No rule references any specific draw's numbers. Every data-driven quantity is computed by code that reads only results/super_lotto/draw1754/draws.json (1577-1753; asserted last draw 1753, #1754 absent).
isolation: Super Lotto only. Code imports only scripts/research/super_lotto.py (V1, unchanged) and scripts/research/common.py (game-agnostic). No Lotto file, parameter, weight, seed, formula or result is used. The formulas below are specific to this design and are not the Lotto P0 formulas.
not_v2: P0 is a separate portfolio challenger. Ticket 1 is always the frozen V1 Science ticket. P0 never modifies V1.

families.A_long: V1 features() row 0 at the origin
families.E_pairs: z(pair_matrix.sum(0)); informative only if std > 1e-10 (at least one Holm-retained pair)
families.F_structure: no number-level representation (whole-ticket objective); used only in Stage B if credible
families.G_ensemble: derived from A-E; reported; number-level credibility fixed at 0 (no double counting)

stage_A_main_discovery.per_origin_evidence: AP excess e_m,u = AP_m,u - AP0, where AP_m,u is V1's own average-precision definition for the origin's 5 winners under the model's V1 ranking (V1 jitter tie-break), and AP0 = exact expected AP of 5 relevant items among 35 under a uniformly random order
stage_A_main_discovery.null_sd: SD of AP under a random order, estimated once by 200,000 Monte Carlo permutations (seed 2026093071)
stage_A_main_discovery.credibility: p_m = one-sided normal p of mean(e_m) / (null_sd / sqrt(n_m)) over the n_m prior informative origins; Holm across the informative families A-E; c_m = max(0, 1 - 2 * p_m_Holm) * s_m, where s_m = 1 if the mean excess is > 0 in both chronological halves of the prior origins, else 0
stage_A_main_discovery.ordering: M descending; ties (including the all-zero case) broken by EQ_i = mean of z over the informative A-E families (declared NON-EVIDENTIAL convention), then by number ascending
stage_A_main_discovery.frozen_for_prospective_use: the credibility weights at the design cutoff #1753 are frozen as constants for the #1754 shadow and all prospective P0 draws; later draws never update them

main_pool_size.evaluation: P0 development targets only (targets before the V1 confirmation window of the design dataset)
main_pool_size.statistic: winners inside the top-K; null Hypergeometric(35, 5, K), expectation 5K/35 (removes the mechanical advantage of larger pools)
main_pool_size.test: exact one-sided p (convolution); Holm across the 4 options; circular 5-block bootstrap 95% lower bound of mean excess (10,000 reps, seed 2026093011); both halves positive
main_pool_size.selection: passing K with the largest standardized excess; if none passes, the predeclared default
main_pool_size.default_rationale: Two challenger tickets hold 10 main numbers; 12 gives them the pool plus slack without forcing low-support fillers; 792 combinations. Chosen before any data. Labelled NO EDGE when used.
main_pool_size.reported: P(>=2, >=3, >=4, all 5 captured) vs random, variance, confirmation capture, downstream portfolio results per K

stage_B_main_tickets.universe: all C(K,5) five-number combinations of the pool (exhaustive)
stage_B_main_tickets.score: T(t) = sum_{m in A..E} c_m * Z[ sum_{i in t} z_m,i ] + c_E_ticket * Z[ pair(t) ] + c_F * Z[ structure(t) ]
stage_B_main_tickets.Z: standardize across all combinations of the pool (0 if constant)
stage_B_main_tickets.pair(t): V1 objective row 5: retained pair lift inside t / 20
stage_B_main_tickets.structure(t): V1 objective row 6: minus mean squared standardized structure distance
stage_B_main_tickets.ticket_level_credibility: c_E_ticket and c_F from the V1 walk-forward main hits of the E_pairs and F_structure tickets: one-sided exact p of total hits (hypergeometric convolution), Holm across the two, c = max(0, 1 - 2 p_Holm) * s (halves rule), minimum 25 prior origins (E counted only where informative)
stage_B_main_tickets.forbidden: no spacing, consecutive, parity, sum, high/low, recent-repeat, overdue or anti-repeat preference, and no reference to any specific draw's numbers
stage_B_main_tickets.tie_breaks: sum of EQ_i over the ticket, then lexicographic

models.S_transition: V1 Holm-gated transition row (flat if no retained transition)

stage_C_super_ball.per_origin_evidence: q_s,u = (10 - midrank of the actual SB)/9 - 0.5 (midranks for ties; a flat model gives 0)
stage_C_super_ball.credibility: one-sided normal p of mean(q_s) over prior informative origins; Holm across the informative S_long..S_transition; c_s = max(0, 1 - 2 p_Holm) * halves rule; minimum 25 prior origins
stage_C_super_ball.score: Q_b = sum_s c_s * z_s,b; ordering by Q, ties by EQ_SB_b (mean of informative SB z, non-evidential), then SB number
stage_C_super_ball.calibration_reported_only: log loss of the Dirichlet(1)-smoothed long-run SB frequency vs the uniform log(10)

stage_D_portfolio.ticket_1: the frozen V1 Science ticket (5 mains + V1 SB)
stage_D_portfolio.main_selection: greedy, ticket 2 then ticket 3: maximize J(t|S) = T(t) + eta * Cov(t|S), eta = 1
stage_D_portfolio.supported_mass: m_i proportional to exp(M_i) over the pool numbers
stage_D_portfolio.incremental_coverage: Cov(t|S) = sum of m_i over numbers of t not already in any selected ticket, divided by 5/K
stage_D_portfolio.overlap_rule: hard: at most 1 shared main number with each already selected ticket (including ticket 1); if infeasible relax to 2, then 3
stage_D_portfolio.evidence_exception: waived only if the sum of all main credibilities > 0 AND the best unconstrained T exceeds the best feasible T by more than 1.0 (absolute T units)

super_ball_rules.A: both challengers get the top-Q SB
super_ball_rules.B: challengers get the top-2 SBs by EQ_SB, distinct from ticket 1's SB
super_ball_rules.C: challengers get the top-2 SBs by Q (ties EQ_SB), distinct from ticket 1's SB (reliability-weighted diversification)
super_ball_rules.D: challengers get independent uniform random SBs (seed 2026093051 + target)

stage_D_portfolio.super_ball_rule_selected: C, unless a Super Ball model passes the V1 SB gate (confirmation Holm p < 0.05, block lower bound > 0.1, both halves > 0.1) at the design cutoff, in which case A. The historical A-D comparison is reported but cannot override this predeclared rule.
stage_D_portfolio.recorded: raw T, J, coverage, overlaps, unique mains, distinct SBs, family contributions, fragility (tickets under alternative K)

historical_test.targets: P0 targets with >= 25 prior V1 origins, through #1753
historical_test.development: P0 targets before the V1 confirmation window (last 40 V1 origins of the design dataset)
historical_test.ticket_1_history: V1-style reconstruction: V1 candidate generator at each cutoff (validated against the frozen #1753 and #1754 pools), V1 gates, and the V1 fixed-seed fallback (index from default_rng(2026092109)); origins where a V1 gate would have passed are flagged

comparators.B: 3 uniform tickets with the same main-overlap rule, uniform SBs
comparators.C: V1 ticket + 2 uniform tickets (<=1 overlap), uniform SBs
comparators.D: 3 highest standalone-T tickets of the pool, SBs by the selected P0 rule
comparators.E: the P0 main tickets with uniform random SBs

historical_test.replicates: 200 per origin for random comparators (seed 2026093021 + target)

metrics.main: best-ticket matches, total main matches, any ticket >=2, >=3, >=4, 5/5
metrics.super_ball: any SB hit, SB hits per ticket
metrics.full: joint outcome of the best-main ticket (mains, SB) and any ticket with >=2 mains + SB

historical_test.null_model: for each fixed portfolio, per-origin null pmfs from 20,000 uniform draws (mains and SB; seed 2026093031 + target); sums over origins by convolution

endpoints: E1 challengers' total main matches (tickets 2+3) vs null
E2 challengers' SB hits vs null
E3 portfolio best-ticket main matches vs null
gate.PASS: E1 Holm p < 0.05 AND bootstrap lower bound of the E1 mean excess > 0 AND E1 excess > 0 in both halves of the confirmation period
gate.otherwise: FAIL: The Super Lotto P0 portfolio is a coverage experiment, not a demonstrated predictive edge.

v2_test_plan: Candidate V1 refinements are limited to existing V1 components (V1's own two-stage construction methods, each main and SB model as the final selector, the fallback seeding design). Each must pass, on V1 walk-forward data through the latest completed draw: confirmation Holm p < 0.05 within its family, a block-bootstrap lower bound above random, and both halves above random. If none passes: NO SUPER LOTTO V2 IS JUSTIFIED.
jev_role: V1: unchanged V1 rules. P0: one audit call after the full portfolio is frozen (robustness, overfit, weak-model dependence, fragility, family concentration); it cannot change any ticket.
random_control: 3 uniform tickets with the same main-overlap rule and uniform SBs, seed 2026093061, research only
